scope: Theorem 1.1 of the manuscript “The Critical Spin Field of the Planar XY Model” (preprints/The-Critical-Spin-Field-of-the-Planar-XY-Model-October-5-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 216 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 486481fbcc54fe62), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 4. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For the fixed-boundary critical XY law (1.3), the distributions Sn in (1.5) converge in law along the full sequence n → ∞ to V∗ in H−3 loc (D). Moreover, for every k ≥ 1, every f1, . . . , fk ∈ C∞ c (D; C), and every collection of nonnegative integers p1, q1, . . . , pk, qk, E0 n k Y j=1 Sn(fj)pj Sn(fj) qj −→ E k Y j=1 V∗(fj)pj V∗(fj) qj . (1.7) The joint laws of these complex smeared fields converge as well. Here H−3 loc (D) consists of distributions T such that χT, extended by zero, belongs to H−3(R2) for every χ ∈ C∞ c (D), with the usual local topology.
